# `Color`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

`Ipe.Color` — build, inspect, and transform sRGB colours.

A `Color` is an opaque sRGB value with red, green, blue, and alpha channels.
It is the single colour type shared across every surface: a value built here
is the same `Color` a DOM view, a terminal view, or a stylesheet consumes, so
a colour is one type everywhere.

The functions cluster into families: constructors (`rgb`, `rgba`, `hsl`,
`hsla`, and the named `white`/`black`/`red`/`green`/`blue`/`transparent`),
accessors that render a colour to text (`toCss`, `toCssRgba`, `toHex`) or read
a scalar off it (`luminance`, the WCAG relative luminance), and manipulation
(`withAlpha`, `mix`, `blend`, `lighten`, `darken`, `saturate`, `desaturate`,
`rotateHue`, `complementary`, `grayscale`).

Every member is a thin binding onto the colour kernels; the colour maths lives
in one place in the runtime, never re-implemented at this surface.

## `rgb`

```ipe
rgb : Int -> Int -> Int -> Color
```

`rgb r g b` — an opaque sRGB colour from red/green/blue channels (0..255),
fully opaque (alpha = 1).

## `rgba`

```ipe
rgba : Int -> Int -> Int -> Float -> Color
```

`rgba r g b a` — an sRGB colour from red/green/blue channels (0..255) and an
alpha channel (0..1).

## `hsl`

```ipe
hsl : Float -> Float -> Float -> Color
```

`hsl h s l` — a colour from hue (degrees), saturation, and lightness (0..1),
fully opaque.

## `hsla`

```ipe
hsla : Float -> Float -> Float -> Float -> Color
```

`hsla h s l a` — an HSL colour with an alpha channel (0..1).

```ipe
white : Color
```

## `toCss`

```ipe
toCss : Color -> String
```

`toCss c` — the CSS `rgb()`/`rgba()` spelling of a colour.

## `toCssRgba`

```ipe
toCssRgba : Color -> String
```

`toCssRgba c` — always the four-channel `rgba()` spelling of a colour.

## `toHex`

```ipe
toHex : Color -> String
```

`toHex c` — the `#rrggbb`/`#rrggbbaa` hex spelling of a colour.

## `luminance`

```ipe
luminance : Color -> Float
```

`luminance c` — the WCAG relative luminance of a colour (0..1).

## `withAlpha`

```ipe
withAlpha : Float -> Color -> Color
```

`withAlpha a c` — replace the alpha channel of `c` with `a` (0..1).

## `mix`

```ipe
mix : Float -> Color -> Color -> Color
```

`mix t a b` — the perceptual blend of `a` and `b` at position `t` (0..1).

## `blend`

```ipe
blend : Color -> Color -> Color
```

`blend src dst` — source-over alpha compositing of `src` onto `dst`.

## `lighten`

```ipe
lighten : Float -> Color -> Color
```

`lighten amount c` — raise the HSL lightness of `c` by `amount` (0..1).

## `darken`

```ipe
darken : Float -> Color -> Color
```

`darken amount c` — lower the HSL lightness of `c` by `amount` (0..1).

## `saturate`

```ipe
saturate : Float -> Color -> Color
```

`saturate amount c` — raise the HSL saturation of `c` by `amount` (0..1).

## `desaturate`

```ipe
desaturate : Float -> Color -> Color
```

`desaturate amount c` — lower the HSL saturation of `c` by `amount` (0..1).

## `rotateHue`

```ipe
rotateHue : Float -> Color -> Color
```

`rotateHue degrees c` — rotate the hue of `c` by `degrees`.

## `complementary`

```ipe
complementary : Color -> Color
```

`complementary c` — the 180°-hue-rotated complement of `c`.

## `grayscale`

```ipe
grayscale : Color -> Color
```

`grayscale c` — fully desaturate `c` to grey.

## `fromHex`

```ipe
fromHex : String -> Result ColorError Color
```

`fromHex s` — parse a `#rgb`/`#rgba`/`#rrggbb`/`#rrggbbaa` hex string,
returning `Err` with a typed `ColorError` on a bad digit or bad length.

## `fromName`

```ipe
fromName : String -> Result ColorError Color
```

`fromName s` — parse a curated named colour, returning `Err` with a typed
`ColorError` when the name is not in the set.

## `trueColorProfile`

```ipe
trueColorProfile : TermProfile
```

The 24-bit truecolour terminal target.

## `ansi256Profile`

```ipe
ansi256Profile : TermProfile
```

The 256-colour xterm-palette terminal target.

## `ansi16Profile`

```ipe
ansi16Profile : TermProfile
```

The 16 SGR-palette terminal target.

## `noColorProfile`

```ipe
noColorProfile : TermProfile
```

The no-colour terminal target (everything degrades to the default).

## `toAnsi`

```ipe
toAnsi : TermProfile -> Color -> AnsiColor
```

`toAnsi profile c` — down-sample `c` for a terminal `profile`. The single
truecolour→256→16 degradation point; the nearest-16 mapping is the runtime SSOT.

## `wcagAa`

```ipe
wcagAa : WcagLevel
```

The WCAG AA conformance level (`4.5:1` normal text, `3.0:1` large text).

## `wcagAaa`

```ipe
wcagAaa : WcagLevel
```

The WCAG AAA conformance level (`7.0:1` normal text, `4.5:1` large text).

## `normalText`

```ipe
normalText : TextSize
```

The normal-size text band.

## `largeText`

```ipe
largeText : TextSize
```

The large-text band (`>=18pt`, or `>=14pt` bold).

## `contrastRatio`

```ipe
contrastRatio : Color -> Color -> Float
```

`contrastRatio a b` — the WCAG contrast ratio between two colours (1..21).

## `readableTextOn`

```ipe
readableTextOn : Color -> Color
```

`readableTextOn bg` — black or white, whichever contrasts more against `bg`.

## `meetsWcag`

```ipe
meetsWcag : WcagLevel -> TextSize -> Color -> Color -> Bool
```

`meetsWcag level size fg bg` — whether `fg` on `bg` meets the WCAG `level`
threshold for text of the given `size`.

## `maximumContrast`

```ipe
maximumContrast : Color -> List Color -> Color
```

`maximumContrast target candidates` — the candidate colour with the highest
contrast against `target` (falls back to `readableTextOn target` — black or
white — when the list is empty).
